selection: All barcodes from full-density Dual rows 0-116 (117 rows × 363 cols = 42471). Not a checkerboard of 4×4 blocks. Printer coordinates: y = col+4, x = 4+2*row (even col) or 5+2*row (odd col), so (x+y) is even.
decoy_rule: Same as full-density Dual: keep each block's bar_1, add round(0.5 × n_real) extra bar_2 from the 18-nt library; 8 decoys per complete 16-spot block.
